signature.public_key: Externally pinned 44-byte SPKI DER; single publisher binding

manifest.encoding: canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; exact field set
manifest.approval: Authenticated host approval of exact manifest SHA-256 and expiry; not client JSON

package.type: single-disk ZIP, stored regular files only

persistence.scope: trusted local host, one subject and fixed policy
persistence.fresh_initialization: only when component marker and every signed_skill_* table are absent
persistence.incomplete_marked_schema: reject without recreating missing tables or policy singleton
persistence.policy_singleton: exactly one id=1 row with persisted policy, valid last_time and suspension state
persistence.unknown_namespaced_table: reject in both fresh and established state

revocation.at_capacity: atomically suspend registry; never evict existing denials
revocation.clock_failure: denial remains available using last observed audit time

transparency.configuration: optional exact built-in verifier whose full key/required policy digest is persisted
transparency.manifest_binding: RFC6962 inclusion leaf is exact canonical manifest bytes
transparency.stored_installation_expiry: also bounded by verified checkpoint/log-key expiry

not_implemented: operated append-only log, checkpoint consistency, gossip or independent witness quorum
whole-database anti-rollback or privileged-row tamper prevention
claim_ceiling: Repository source implementation and tests only. Inclusion verification is admission-time only; no E5-E7, global log honesty, general execution permission or full HG-0087/skills closure.
